name: 24422 · Clifton Forge, VA
findings: ZIP 24422 (Clifton Forge) has 25 nonprofit organizations. 14 of them (56%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 10 organizations.
Economic development organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 24422 (Clifton Forge) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
29% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
